value.subject: github-actions-scheduler
value.obligation: incident-scheduled-run-failures: diagnose the consecutive-failure class on scheduled refresh workflows (Commit-step double failures that recover unexamined) and give the class a named failure class in lib/ops/failure-classes.ts
value.why: Recorded as tracker rows JOB04 and JOB06: refresh-daily.yml failed runs 32955499285 and 32833989579 both at step Commit (6 failures in its last 6 completed runs at the time of reading); intake-tripwire.yml failed runs 32961466707 and 32840268606 both at step 'Commit the report if changed' and recovered unexamined. Two consecutive failures at the same repo-owned step is evidence the cause is ours; nobody has diagnosed why, so each recurrence starts from nothing. RULING 218: an automatable scheduled-run failure routes to an operational incident and WorkItem, never to the owner by itself.
